eyebrow: The two most common real findings
code:
Stale access
  Ex-employee account never disabled
  Admin role from a migration, never revoked

Missing logging
  Logging disabled on a resource
  Retention shorter than the audit period
caption: Neither finding requires a sophisticated attacker — just nobody noticing.
